name: astro-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins for solo hobby projects.

plugins.name: inline-thinking
plugins.description: Draws Claude's thinking in the chat, above the reply or tool call it led to, in place of the folded "Thought for 4s".

plugins.name: gates
plugins.description: Gates that refuse risky Bash commands (pkill, kill by pattern) and tell Claude why and what to run instead.

plugins.name: global-memory
plugins.description: Memories Claude writes for every project, kept in ~/.claude/memory and loaded into each session, and /global-memory, a menu to browse, read and delete them.

plugins.name: github-tracking
plugins.description: Keeps a repo's GitHub issues, milestones and Projects board true while Claude works: a script moves issues and PRs on the board, makes sub-issues and posts status updates. /github-tracking:init sets up the board and its views, and /github-tracking:migrate moves a repo's corkboard items onto it. Its track skill says which work gets an issue and how to write one.

plugins.name: screen-polish
plugins.description: Polishes Claude Code's terminal: inline code on a background, distinct heading levels, drawn rules, task-list checkboxes and quote bars in replies, plus optional tool-call rows, prompt marker and spinner words. Each turns on or off in /config.

plugins.name: bug-hunt
plugins.description: /bug-hunt:hunt finds bugs and reproduces each one before calling it a bug: a whole codebase component by component, a path or area, or a change that Claude Code's /code-review reviews first.

plugins.name: project-md
plugins.description: Creates PROJECT.md, a committed file that describes a project's purpose and scope, and loads it into every session without an import in CLAUDE.md. Run /project-md:review at any time to compare recent work with the file. It changes the file only with your approval.

plugins.name: plain-english
plugins.description: Makes Claude write plain language as ISO 24495-1 defines it, in a professional, neutral tone, so readers can easily find, understand and use what it writes. An output style for the main conversation and forks, and the same instructions handed to every subagent.

plugins.name: docs-site
plugins.description: /docs-site:init sets up a repo's docs site in one script run: a mkdocs.yml with no nav list, a docs home page and site/ in .gitignore, so `uvx zensical serve` shows the Markdown in docs/ with a sidebar, sections and search. /docs-site:hub serves every repo's site at once in Docker, each at http://NAME.localhost:8099, with a dashboard that lists them.

plugins.name: instructions
plugins.description: /instructions:init sets up and reviews a project's CLAUDE.md and CLAUDE.local.md and your global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md. A fork of Claude Code's new /init that checks each file against Claude Code's docs and prompt audit, and shows every draft before writing.
